title: Uka Juiciojj Olanakan manqhankiwa
intro: Mä profetax misionerjam qʼiptʼataw mä amtar puritayna, ukatwa markapat jayarstʼäna ukat jan suytʼat yantʼaruw purirakïna. Viajepax wali muspharkañänwa, iyawsäwipa ukat pacienciap wali ch’ullqhi yant’äna. ¿Uka extraordinario eventon detalles ukanakap uñacht’ayat p’iqinchawinakat amuyt’asmati?
clues: Mä profetaruw mä markar khitapxäna, ukampis jankʼakiw sarxäna, jupanakan jan iyawsatapatxa chuym chʼallxtataw jikxatasïna.
Viajepajj qotaruw irpäna, ukanwa mä jachʼa qʼiptʼat barcor makatäna, uka barcojj pasañ thaqänwa.
Mä jachʼa thayaw sartasïna, ukat barcor jan waltʼayäna, ukat mä jaqerojj qotar jaqontañaw amtasïna, ukhamat carga jan sinti chʼamäñapataki, ukajj sorteonakampiw amtasïna.
Jupajj manqhankir mä animalamp manqʼantatäjjänwa, ukajj Diosan munañaparjamaw mä milagro lurasïna.
Uka lurat puraka manqhanxa, Tatituparuw jawsäna, arrepentisisaw chʼamakan Diosar jachʼañcharakïna.
Mä qhawqha tiempojj wali achiktʼasisaw mä qʼañu qota lakan jaqontapjjäna, jan chʼamanïkchïnsa jakaskänwa, qhepatjja kuttʼanjjänwa, ukat markapajj qhepat creyipjjänwa.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
